name: Jumping-shrimp pancakes
summary: A small rice-flour pancake about a hand wide, filled with bean sprouts and seafood, usually shrimp and sometimes squid. You eat several, rolled in rice paper with herbs.
origin: Phu Yen. Du lịch Phú Yên’s 6 October 2024 cẩm nang and its food roundup both describe this pancake.
texture: Each cake is about a quarter the size of a southern bánh xèo. The batter is rice flour alone, mixed to the cook’s own formula, with no wheat.
howToEat: Roll it in rice paper with herbs and dip it in sweet-sour fish sauce or mắm nêm.
where: Lê Duẩn and Chu Mạnh Trinh.
seoTitle: Banh xeo tom nhay — a small Phu Yen pancake
seoDescription: Hand-wide rice-flour pancakes with shrimp and sprouts, rolled in rice paper with herbs, on Le Duan and Chu Manh Trinh.
